theorem absolute_graph (f : GaussianL2) (g : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hfg : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => |f X|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => BrownianSignIntegral.signum (f X) • g X) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ ‖g‖

theorem minimum_graph (f h : GaussianL2) (g k : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hf : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph)
    (hh : (h,k) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => min (f X) (h X)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => (1/2:ℝ) •
        (g X+k X-BrownianSignIntegral.signum (f X-h X) • (g X-k X))) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ ‖g‖+‖k‖

theorem closed_graph {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (f : GaussianL2) (g : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hfg : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => value c (f X)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => coefficient c (f X) • g X) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ c*‖g‖

theorem folded_graph (R : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => |process R Y|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] foldedGradient R ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ)

theorem overlap_graph (R S : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => min |process R Y| |process S Y|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] overlapGradient R S ∧
      ‖G‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (S : ℝ)

theorem damping_graph (b : ι → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,

      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] dampingGradient b r ∧
